description: This is a test class for the TimeReportAPI within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It contains unit tests and integration tests for API endpoints related to Project Reports, specifically testing the 'getOne' endpoint and ensuring that other methods throw not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: ProjectReportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the Project Report API endpoints, particularly focusing on the 'getOne' API method and ensuring other methods like 'delete' and 'update' are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' endpoint of the API, ensuring it returns valid data based on parameterized test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data from a YAML data file to parameterize the 'testGetOne' method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling delete on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule for delete operation is not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that calling update on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule for update operation is not implemented.
